goal:
Measure, upgrade board3 in place, and run the whole loop with evidence. Spec: docs/payments/2026-11-01-paid-board-revision-spec.md §C5 and §C7.

SCOPE
- FIRST, a faithful test token. board3's configured token metapoo-mpoo.testnet is NOT an mPOO copy (found 2 Nov): it is a TOILET-style contract (code hash 63LL5cgbbGdHkDotViy6u3mRfsV4LwmmuuhyEHJjozvp) with mint/emitter, 0 bps tax, 2,000 supply. Deploy the real mainnet mPOO wasm (code hash HS4R2isPS7hnnY8k2QbxnLHUx9Z9v9mNZnLsrGqwhChh, fetch with RPC view_code on mpoo.nearlytrade.near) to a new testnet account, initialised like mainnet's tx GGW2hNsp6ZqD2gTk8Q11B3WTUuLTsEiSP6NKNEehnkVq (owner, total supply 1e27, tax admin, exempt list, rules null; use testnet accounts you control and a test pool account in pairs). Point the upgraded board at it in migrate/new (the token id is fixed at new, so this may need a fresh testnet board rather than board3 - decide and record why). Register the 64-zero burn address with storage_deposit on that token before the first distribute_mpoo.
- C5: measure storage_usage on testnet for 100 first paints (distinct accounts and one account), 100 registrations, 100 free-cell flags. Replace STORAGE_PER_PIXEL with the measured figure +10% in a small PR; check the 0.01 NEAR registration fee covers an account plus AccountExtra.
- Record board3's code hash and reads (get_credits for 3+ accounts with balances, get_pixels, get_outstanding_credits) before the upgrade.
- upgrade(code, migrate_args) with the owner's dedicated testnet team and buyback accounts.
- Same reads after: unchanged.
- Full loop with transaction hashes: register, buy with NEAR, buy with the test mPOO (cap above 0), paint using a free first paint, paint a stroke with max_credits, distribute_near, revenue mPOO from the buyback account, distribute_mpoo.
- Measure gas per distribute call for the keeper's budget.

ACCEPTANCE
- Every hash and read recorded in testnet-deployment-2026-10.md (new section). PAY-INTEGRATION and PAY-UPGRADE in the backlog updated with the evidence.

BEFORE YOU START
Read AGENT.md, docs/learning/traps.md and the spec section named above. Contract changes were approved by the owner on 1 Nov for this revision only, on testnet. Do not deploy to mainnet.

DONE MEANS
AGENT.md's definition of done: tests named that fail before and pass after, cargo test / npm test / npm run build as relevant, a '## Learned' line in the PR, and docs/backlog.md updated in the same PR.
